daemon.description: Whether to run Mailnag as a background daemon service (recommended for production).

check_interval.description: Seconds between automatic mailbox checks. Lower values increase responsiveness but also server load.

pidfile.description: Absolute path to the PID file used to track the daemon process.

accounts.description: List of mail accounts to monitor. Each entry defines a POP3/IMAP/OAuth2 mailbox.

port.description: Server port (e.g., 993 for IMAPS, 995 for POP3S).

ssl.description: Use SSL/TLS encryption for server connection.

starttls.description: Use STARTTLS upgrade on non-SSL connections (e.g., port 143→143+STARTTLS).

username.description: Email address or username for authentication.

password.description: Password or app-specific password. For security, consider leaving blank to prompt or use environment variables.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 credentials for modern providers (e.g., Gmail with OAuth2).

client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID from provider console.

refresh_token.description: OAuth2 refresh token (obtained via initial OAuth flow).

notifications.description: List of notification methods to trigger on new mail. Supports desktop, sound, or email forwarding.

name.description: Type of notification plugin to enable.

summary_template.description: Jinja2 template for notification summary (variables: count, accounts, messages).

body_template.description: Jinja2 template for notification body (variables: count, messages, accounts).

icon.description: Path to icon file for desktop notifications (optional).

sound_file.description: Path to sound file (e.g., '/usr/share/sounds/generic.wav') for sound notifications.

from_addr.description: Sender email address for forwarded notifications.

to_addr.description: Recipient email address to notify (e.g., your secondary inbox).

storage_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database used to store mail metadata, seen flags, and last-check timestamps.
